items.title: the three targets, their families and the predictions

given.statement: PREDICTIONS, which the gate replaces (W48 Decision Log 5): W47's three targets, each a stratum × pose aggregate halved per profile (P pooled over both poses with P rest and P inactive reported beside it; C rest; F inactive). Predictions from W47's ladders and W46's point A, stated here and hashed in part 1 as predictions the gate replaces: - **C rest halves at both scales** at operator 1's closest rung: the thin gain is point A's (W46's C rest fell 0.390 → 0.171 at 1x and 0.538 → 0.238 at 2x at `tintAlpha` 0.7), and the thick cells sit inside the budget instead of 10–12 B away. - **F inactive's fine band falls by at least 0.73 of its excess** at tap σ 4 (R .728 / .753 at 1x, 1.005 / .967 at 2x), the whole band by 2.3–3.9 B; the joint with the receded transmission 0.8 keeps it (R .736 / .767 and 1.044 / 1.011). - **P is not halved from these operators alone** (W47 part 1's prediction: operator 1 alone 0.759 / 0.740 against 0.879 / 0.965 at the reference; the receded photo body at point A ×0.42–0.46). The gate reads it; if it is not halved, the landing rule's improvement clause reads what is. - **The budget** is predicted to hold at operator 1's closest rung (two coarse thick cells away per scale) and to be at risk from the mid-span coarse cells (`checkerboard-lc16` md / ml / lg read 2.8–4.6 B away at point A, which operator 1's gain knot and not its far knot governs). - **The level check's excesses** (`hc-text-28__rrect-md__rest` −0.005 to −0.032, `impulse__rrect-sm__rest` +0.0074 / +0.0083 on every 0.7 rung; none failing L1) are read beside L1 at every stage and in the gate report, ungated. - **S1 dark** read and not gated, direction as W47 predicted.

items.title: the corrected protocol (Decision Log 3) and the verdict reader

perScale: no thick cell whose away band reads `away` with growth > awayCeilingB x B
at most awayBeyondBMax of the five whose away band reads `away` with growth > B
no thick cell over Apple at the reference on its change band (reference > native) reads `away`: `toward` and `unchanged` are both admitted, the rule's own states
the thin rest cells keep at least half of point A's gain (W47 ladder (i)'s thin clause, unchanged: reread.json thinKeepsHalf)
L1 passes on its population (W47's level reading, unchanged: reread.json L1passes)
operator 1.reads: reread.json rungs[label].perScale[scale]: thick[cell].changeBand and .awayBand {n, c, k, B, growth, change}, thinGain, pointAThinGain, thinKeepsHalf, L1passes

perScale: each fine cell: E = fine(reference) - fine(native) > 0 and R = (fine(reference) - fine(rung)) / E >= fineExcessRemovedMin on T1-fine
each guard: whole-band T1 (k - c) / B >= -guardFloorB
beside, deciding nothing: each fine cell's whole-band fall -g / B, carried to the gate
operator 2.reads: reread.json rungs[label].perScale[scale]: fine.cells[cell] {native, reference, rung, E, R, wholeFallInB}, guards.deltaInB

joint.reading: operator 1's partition (a) over the four readings (the two fine cells at 1x and 2x) on their change and away bands, and operator 2's halving (b) on each; the photo inactive ratio against point A's is reported and decides nothing; ladder (iv) decides only name-target

2x width.reading: not re-stated and not re-read (W47 Decision Log 8; W48 Decision Log 4): results.json operators['2x width'] stands; the second tap is not a stage-1 member and no 1x gap is named

separation.operator 1: separates when a ladder (i) rung meets bar (a) at BOTH scales
separation.operator 2: the tap separates when a ladder (iii) tap rung (sizeFineTapSigma / sizeFineTapShare) meets bar (b) at BOTH scales; the receded body width meets when a ladder (iii) optics.regular.blurSigma rung does; when both meet, both are stage-2 members and the gate reads both (Decision Log 3 (c); no precedence)
separation.oneScale: a rung meeting at one scale only is recorded and is not a fit start (Decision Log 3 (f)); the ones the parent ruled off the grid are `offGrid`; any OTHER rung meeting at one scale only stops part 2 for the parent (W47's one-scale rule stands for the fit)

offGrid.note: Decision Log 3 (f) and Decision Log 4, ruled before any W48 verdict from W47's re-read as the charter quotes it; part 2's grids carry none of these values

expected.what: the charter's predictions (clause 3's Bar), hashed here BEFORE the verdicts; verdicts.py reports each against the reading and a difference is said, never absorbed

joint.note: misses the photo floor by 0.02 / 0.01 bar (recorded; the joint decides only name-target)

parentRulings.decision-log-3-a: operator 1's separating bar is the landing rule's partition on the five thick rest cells against Apple, with `unchanged` admitted on the over-Apple cells (closes W47 Decision Log 8's "toward" clause, which failed a rung inside the budget on `hc-text-7` at −0.30 / 0.00 B);
parentRulings.decision-log-3-b: operator 2 is read on T1-fine, R ≥ 0.5 per cell and scale, the whole band reported beside it (closes the whole-band bar);
parentRulings.decision-log-3-c: when the receded body width and the tap both meet (b), both are stage-2 members and the gate reads both; there is no precedence decision kind (closes body-width-first, which named the stronger lever unfitted);
parentRulings.decision-log-3-d: `hold` joins the decision kinds: a non-operator leaf may be held at a named value without flat rungs (closes `strike` as the only removal); the parent may hold `sizeOcclusionGain` at 0.05 and the span tops at part 2 if the ladders' gain reading argues it;
parentRulings.decision-log-3-e: `check-fit` validates part 2 against `verdicts.json`, the Decision Log 3 reading (closes the check that read the original bars' `results.json`);
parentRulings.decision-log-3-f: the σ 2 and share 0.5 rungs, which met at one scale only, are off the grid: a lever that meets at one scale is not a fit start (ruled now; W47's one-scale rule stands for the fit);
parentRulings.decision-log-3-g: `amend` and `amend-fit` refuse an empty ops list (closes the empty-ops defect).

decisionLog8.reading: meets bar (a) at 1x only: its 2x thin gain 0.0629 is under half of point A's 0.1384 (ladders/verdicts.json under 87ec90d48155)
decisionLog8.decision: under Design (f) a one-scale rung is not a fit start and is recorded; its point (tintAlpha 0.8, gain 0.6, far 0, top 256) is on no W48 grid, so the grids stay exactly as pinned
decisionLog8.tool: declare.py check-fit records a one-scale rung whose point is on no grid of part 2 (one_scale_reading) instead of stopping on it; a one-scale rung on a grid still stops
decisionLog8.unchanged: no bar, verdict reader, grid, target, reference or protocol decision changes; the verdicts are re-read under the amended hash and must repeat byte for byte
